signatureConcept: Calm minimalist dealer with a left-anchored single hero photo against generous whitespace, hairline-borderless chrome, and sentence-case display titles in a formal voice
designerNotes: Minimalist archetype is currently empty in the fingerprint registry — first theme of its kind.
Sentence-case display headlines (per feedback_title_treatment_variance). NO UPPERCASE blanket on h1-h4.
Zero decorative layers — no glow blobs, no grid overlays, no shimmer strips. Whitespace IS the design.
Compact-list inventory: horizontal rows with thumb left, specs middle, price+CTA right. Distinct from every showroom-grid sibling.
Story-driven vehicle detail: full-bleed lead photo, sentence-case headline, narrative-flow content blocks, sidebar facts.
Hairline chrome: 52px header, 1px hairline border-bottom, no top contact bar (contact lives in footer).
All paired tokens derive from dashboard --color-* pickers (per feedback_dashboard_tokens_drive_all_surfaces).
No hardcoded brand-primary RGB literals — use color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-primary) X%, transparent) (per feedback_hardcoded_colors_in_themes).
Hero caps: 1 eyebrow, 1 headline, 1 lead, 1 primary CTA + 1 secondary (phone), 0 chip rows, 0 search forms (per feedback_hero_simplicity_balance).
